_readme: Coral Petal AI Academy catalog. ONE file to maintain: add a course = add one entry to 'courses'. Every tag a course uses must be listed in a 'tagGroups' group (the site checks this). level = Beginner | Intermediate | Advanced. slug = lowercase-with-hyphens, unique; the detail page is /course/?id=<slug>.
